name: Conventional Vampires
source:
Conventional Vampires is a queer, safe for work, campy vampire visual novel set in a convention. There are three routes to explore and plenty of wonderful interactions to be had--will you dare to try it?

It's been a few years since you were last in the big city, and the first thing you decide to do after unpacking the boxes at your new apartment is to go to a silly, spooky, monster fan convention: All Hallow’s Con.

The con seems like a great way to meet other queer folks in the area, and best of all, it ends with a festive ball on Halloween! There's no telling what might be laying in store for you at All Hallow's Con...

Just who will you meet when the doors open on Hallow’s Eve?

[From [url=https://tedsybear.itch.io/conventional-vampires]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《传统吸血鬼》是一部以传统为背景的酷儿、工作安全、做作的吸血鬼视觉小说。三种探索路线，丰富精彩互动，你敢尝试吗？

自从你上次来到大城市已经有几年了，在新公寓打开箱子后你决定做的第一件事就是去参加一个愚蠢、怪异、怪物的粉丝大会：万圣节派对。

这个骗局似乎是结识该地区其他酷儿人士的好方法，最重要的是，它以万圣节的节日舞会结束！不知道万圣节大会上会发生什么……

当万圣节前夕大门打开时，你会遇到谁？

[来自[url=https://tedsybear.itch.io/conventional-vampires]Itch.io[/url]]
